players.s: India's government-run postal operator, which delivers parcels through a network of about 1.64 lakh post offices and has signed last-mile delivery agreements with private logistics and e-commerce companies.

Blue Dart is an Indian express air and ground courier and parcel carrier. It is majority-owned by DHL through DHL Express (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. and signed an agreement on 9 October 2026 to use India Post's network for parcel delivery.

Irish customs clearance and e-commerce logistics specialist that runs a digital customs clearance platform and the drop2shop pickup and drop-off network of more than 500 locations in the Republic of Ireland for deliveries and returns, and was acquired by Evri in 2025.

Belarus's largest online hypermarket, operated by Triovist, which received a postal licence in June 2026 and launched its own parcel delivery service, 21vek.by POST, with branches in Minsk and nearby suburbs.
Belposhta is the state-owned national postal operator of Belarus. It handles domestic and international mail, parcels, EMS express and courier delivery.

DHL Supply Chain is DHL Group's contract logistics division. It provides warehousing, transport, e-commerce fulfillment and returns management, and describes itself as the world's leading contract logistics provider.
al: Exel (former North America name, until January 2016)

players.s: GOFO France is the French last-mile parcel delivery arm of GOFO, formerly CIRRO Parcel. It provides home delivery for e-commerce merchants and logistics providers across metropolitan France through its own sorting hubs and routing technology.
Los Angeles private equity firm that owns Duncan Solutions (parking and tolling revenue management) and has invested in National Freight, a linehaul contractor carrying trailers for FedEx Ground.
RPS was the ground small-package carrier started in 1985 by Roadway Services (later Caliber System) and rebranded FedEx Ground in 2000 after FedEx acquired Caliber in 1998.
FedEx subsidiary, formerly Roberts Express, that provides exclusive-use expedited ground and air freight across North America for urgent, high-value, hazardous and temperature-controlled shipments.
Operates a carrier-neutral network of roughly 3,000 open parcel lockers in Germany and Austria, used by several parcel carriers for delivery, pickup, shipping and returns.
players.role: Carrier-neutral parcel locker network in Germany and Austria

players.s: Sereact develops Cortex, a physical-AI software platform that runs warehouse picking and dual-arm returns-handling robots at 3PLs and retailers, and it is sold under a Robotics-as-a-Service model.

European online fashion retailer and marketplace that runs its own fulfillment and returns network (Zalando Fulfillment Solutions) for itself and Partner Program brands, using third-party logistics providers and national carriers for warehousing and last-mile delivery.

The UN specialized agency for postal cooperation, it sets the rules and standards that let its 192 member countries exchange international mail and parcels, and it provides shared postal systems such as the Customs Declaration System and a delivered-duty-paid landed-cost tool.
Toronto-based tech-enabled 3PL that combines e-commerce fulfillment, an electric-vehicle last-mile delivery fleet and returns processing for DTC brands in Canada and the U.S.
Poshmark is a resale marketplace that issues sellers a prepaid, pre-addressed USPS shipping label on every sale and handles carrier claims for its buyers and sellers.

Mercari is a Tokyo-based C2C marketplace that sells U.S. sellers prepaid USPS, UPS and FedEx shipping labels and offers a UPS Store Pack and Ship service, and it runs anonymous parcel shipping in Japan.
Online marketplace that sells discounted USPS, UPS and FedEx shipping labels to its sellers through eBay Labels and runs the eBay International Shipping cross-border program.
Etsy operates an online marketplace for handmade, vintage and creative goods, and sells discounted USPS, UPS, FedEx and other carrier shipping labels to its U.S. sellers.

Ecom Logistics is a Canadian 3PL that combines ecommerce fulfillment, its own last-mile delivery fleet, freight and technology, and it recently launched Ecom NOW same-day delivery for Shopify merchants.

Broadscale Fulfillment LLC operates Brokfill, an ecommerce and distribution order-fulfillment platform (warehousing, order processing, shipping management) that on Oct. 13, 2026 announced it routes eligible orders to USPS for final-mile delivery to residential, rural and P.O. Box addresses nationwide.
Linnworks is a multichannel commerce operations software platform whose shipping management tools let online sellers rate-shop carriers, print labels, track parcels and route orders to 3PLs.

The UPS Store, Inc. is the franchisor of a network of more than 5,000 franchised retail locations in the U.S., Canada and Puerto Rico that offer packing, shipping, postal, printing and business services, and it is a wholly owned subsidiary of UPS.

Singapore-based trade-technology company, a wholly-owned subsidiary of PSA International, that provides customs filing and clearance software and managed services for U.S. e-commerce and low-value parcel imports (Section 321/Type 86, ACE eManifest) used by brokers, forwarders and importers.
Alphabet is the publicly traded holding company of Google and the Other Bets. It is the parent of Wing, the drone delivery company that flies Walmart orders to U.S. customers.

U.S. general-merchandise retailer that uses its nearly 2,000 stores as fulfillment hubs for Order Pickup, Drive Up and same-day delivery (via its wholly owned subsidiary Shipt), and for parcels shipped through common carriers.

Coco Robotics (corporate name Cyan Robotics Inc.) operates remotely supervised sidewalk delivery robots that carry restaurant and local orders in U.S. cities such as Los Angeles, Chicago and Miami, and in Helsinki, including through Uber Eats and DoorDash.

Zipline designs, manufactures and operates autonomous delivery drones and the distribution hubs behind them, carrying medical supplies, retail goods and restaurant orders to customers in the U.S. and several other countries.
Retailer that runs its own delivery network, including the Spark Driver gig platform, drone delivery with partners such as Wing, and the GoLocal white-label last-mile service for other merchants.
The USPS is the independent federal postal operator of the United States, and it delivers mail and packages to more than 170 million addresses and runs retail post office services.
Expeditors is a non-asset-based global logistics company that provides air and ocean freight forwarding, customs brokerage and related warehousing and distribution services.
NFI is a family-owned North American 3PL that runs warehousing and distribution, eCommerce fulfillment with parcel shipping, dedicated trucking, port drayage, intermodal and freight brokerage.

GEODIS's North American arm, run from Brentwood, Tennessee, provides freight forwarding, contract logistics and warehousing and distribution services for shippers in the U.S. and across North America.

Forward Air is an asset-light freight company that runs expedited LTL and airport-to-airport ground services, intermodal drayage, and, through its Omni Logistics segment, air and ocean forwarding, customs brokerage and contract logistics for U.S. shippers.
Pirate Ship is a free web-based shipping software platform that lets small businesses and e-commerce sellers buy and print discounted USPS and UPS labels, with no monthly fee or markup.

Stripe is a payments and financial-infrastructure company. Its Stripe Capital lending product will use FedEx Dataworks shipment signals to finance small businesses that ship with FedEx, and Stripe also offers shipping-rate lookups through EasyPost and Shippo.
South Bronx-based Amazon Delivery Service Partner that runs last-mile package delivery for Amazon's DYN9 delivery station in Hunts Point, using Amazon-branded cargo vans.
al: Northstar Logistics LLC DBA Northstar Logistics NYC

players.s: Veteran-owned Amazon Delivery Service Provider that delivers Amazon packages in the Bronx and Queens, NY, from Amazon's DYY5 delivery station in Morris Park.

Dematic is a KION Group brand that designs, installs and supports warehouse and distribution-center automation (conveyors, sortation, AS/RS, robotics and software), and it lists parcel as one of the industries it serves.
Intelligrated designs, builds and services warehouse automation (conveyor, sortation, robotics, AS/RS, palletizing and software) for retail, e-commerce, distribution and parcel operations.

Vanderlande designs, builds and services automated parcel and postal sorting systems, along with airport baggage handling and warehouse automation, for parcel carriers, postal operators and e-commerce companies.

Foundation-owned Austrian systems integrator that designs, builds and maintains automated warehouse and fulfillment systems, including parcel and carton sortation (SmartPocket, Natrix sorters), for e-commerce and omnichannel retailers in Europe, Asia and North America.
